Technical

Stats

Goblin_Melee
Goblin Brawlers are generic goblin NPCs and enemies found throughout Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. They are the grunts of the ranks, little more than cannon fodder used to block enemies or support more capable allies. Devoid of notable skills or tactics, they are one of the weakest goblins to be encountered.
